name: China Electronics Technology Group Corporation 52nd Research Institute
zh: 中国电子科技集团公司第五十二研究所
aliases: China Electronics Technology HIK Group Co., Ltd.

evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China Electronics Technology Group Corporation 52nd Research Institute”, one of the research institutes of China Electronics Technology Group Corporation (CETC). CETC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists. The US Commerce Department listed it in December 2021 for supporting China’s military modernization.
It belongs to CETC, which describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government.

sources.title: Addition of Certain Entities to the Entity List and Revision of an Entry on the Entity List (86 FR 71557, 17 December 2021)
